parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key for safe retries of a paid request

spot.description: Underlying price S (> 0). Equity spot OR power/commodity forward mark for the option's window.

strike.description: Strike price K (> 0) in the same units as spot.

timeToExpiry.description: Time to expiry T in years (≥ 0). Required unless expiration is set. Mutually exclusive with expiration.

rate.description: Continuously compounded risk-free rate r (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). For futures-style early exercise set r≈dividendYield.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility σ as a decimal (> 0). Applies over the vol-accrual window τ.

dividendYield.description: Continuous dividend / convenience / yield q (≥ 0, default 0).

optionStyle.description: Exercise style (default "european"). American uses CRR binomial with early exercise.

forwardStart.description: ISO-8601 start of vol/exercise window. If ≤ now, behaves like plain option to expiration.

expiration.description: ISO-8601 end of vol/exercise window. Mutually exclusive with timeToExpiry.

treeSteps.description: CRR steps for American (default 200 on single price).

forward.description: Forward mark F for model=black76 (preferred). If omitted, spot is used as F.

model.description: Pricing model: "bsm" (default European BSM on spot) or "black76" (forward/futures).

greekConvention.description: Greek units: "raw" (vega/1.0 vol, theta/year, rho/1.0 rate) or "trading" (vega/1%, theta/day, rho/bp).

schema.title: OptionPriceRequest
schema.description: European (default) or American option fair value. Legacy bodies use timeToExpiry year-fractions. Optional forwardStart+expiration (ISO-8601 with Z/offset) define a vol/exercise window; τ = years in that window (ACT/365.25), not calendar time from purchase. Not a swing/multi-exercise engine.

post.summary: Price options on a submitted IV surface
post.description: Price one or more European options on a submitted implied-vol surface. Convention: log_moneyness_forward with k=ln(K/F). Interpolation: total_variance_bilinear (w=σ²T in k,T). wingRule=flat_vol (clamp to edge vol; no wing model). Caps: MAX_SURFACE_POINTS / MAX_SURFACE_PRICE_OPTIONS. Paid via x402: $0.08 USDC per request. Prefer /v1/option/price for scalar σ.

post.summary: Book reval on IV surface with sticky smile shocks
post.description: Revalue a book on a submitted IV surface: base vs scenario on the same total-variance bilinear interpolator. Sticky: moneyness (default) | strike | fixed_vol. Shocks: underlyingRel XOR underlyingAbs, rateBp, timeDays, volAbs, volRel, smileTwist (vol points per unit k). Vol order: interpolate → volAbs → volRel → smileTwist*k. Greeks are sticky-σ BS Greeks (NOT full smile bump deltas). Paid via x402: $0.15 USDC. Prefer /v1/portfolio/scenario for scalar-σ books.

PriceFromSurfaceRequest.title: PriceFromSurfaceRequest
PriceFromSurfaceRequest.description: Price European options on a submitted IV surface via total-variance bilinear interpolation in log-moneyness k=ln(K/F). Duplicate (k,T) rejected. Soft warnings for calendar/butterfly issues; grid is not repaired.

surfaceConvention.description: Only log_moneyness_forward is supported in v1

wingRule.description: Clamp to nearest edge vol; no wing model invented

ScenarioShockSurface.description: All fields optional (default 0). underlyingRel XOR underlyingAbs — reject if both set. Vol order: interpolate → volAbs → volRel → smileTwist*k.

underlyingRel.description: Relative F shock applied to every leg

timeDays.description: Roll each T by timeDays/365 (floor at small epsilon), then interpolate σ

smileTwist.description: Extra tilt vs k: σ_used += smileTwist * k (vol points per unit log-moneyness)

ScenarioFromSurfaceRequest.title: ScenarioFromSurfaceRequest
ScenarioFromSurfaceRequest.description: Book reval on an IV surface under sticky moneyness/strike/fixed_vol with optional F, rate, time, and vol shocks.

sticky.description: After F→F′: moneyness reads k′=ln(K/F′); strike reads old k=ln(K/F_base); fixed_vol keeps σ from base k (still applies volAbs/volRel/twist)

results.description: Per-option price, interpolated σ, k, F, Greeks

legs.description: Per-leg base vs scenario value, σ, k/F, sticky-σ Greeks

warnings.description: wing clamp, tenor extrapolate, both-shocks-set, T clipped, etc.

x402.description: x402 micropayment (HTTP 402). Settle USDC exact on Solana and/or Base, then retry with payment proof. Free discovery operations set security: [] and must not expect 402.
